title: The Last Room
author: Noor Thackeray
blurb: Ivo Blackwood, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
